notablePrerequisites: Basalt Monolith does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Katsumasa by paying {2}{U}, causing Basalt Monolith to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Basalt Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Basalt Monolith's last ability by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.
